context: Two managers prep a vendor proposal
purpose: Teach: 役人/図っ/担う/立案/当方/所管/登記/全額

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案の立案、当方の名前で出してOK?
lines.en: For the proposal — is it okay to submit under our name?
lines.style: Crisp, efficient opening. Light forward momentum. Professional but seeking confirmation. No doubt in the voice, just protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。所管役員の決裁は今朝降りました。
lines.en: Yes. The exec with jurisdiction signed off this morning.
lines.style: Clean, factual delivery. Slight upward inflection at the close — confirmation complete. Steady eye contact. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 相手側の役人、登記の件にも詳しい人を引っ張れる?
lines.en: Can we get someone from their side who knows the registration side well?
lines.style: Measured, thinking-aloud quality. Slight pause before 'registration' — weighing options. Strategic but not rushed. Leaning forward slightly in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 試みます。連絡を図っているところです。
lines.en: I'll make it happen. Already reaching out.
lines.style: Steady commitment. No hesitation. Quiet confidence without bravado. The assurance of someone already in motion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 費用の見積もり、全額を一度で出すか、分割か、決めとこ。
lines.en: We need to decide: do we quote the full cost upfront or in stages?
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Slight emphasis on 'decide' — this needs settling now. Practical tempo. Waiting for input but owning the question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 分割で行きます。先方が担うリスク減らせるので。
lines.en: Split it. Reduces their risk exposure that way.
lines.style: Firm close. Quick reasoning offered without over-explaining. Slight nod of finality. The tone of someone who's thought this through already.
